## 297e46df4407

**Reproduced test-portability defect; generator source not modified.** The task's
focused test computes `ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]` and opens
`ROOT / "data/canonical/puzzles.jsonl"`. In the portable task-test runtime this
resolves beneath `generators/297e46df4407/`, so preflight stops before pytest.

Evidence: `checks/audit/297e46df4407/task-tests-runtime/result.json` records
exit 2, `test_status="preflight_failed"`, and a
`fixed_depth_canonical_path` error at test line 21. The repository-local direct
pytest attempt also failed at collection because the per-puzzle import layout
was not installed; the supported portable stage is the decisive reproducer.
The repair is to use `reviewer_support.find_root(__file__)`, `canonical_path`,
and `canonical_pairs`. I did not change this audit-only target or claim a
semantic generator defect from this test failure.
